pricing.details: Free 0 €, free forever — 10 GB storage, limited usage, native integrations. Plus 45 €/month — 1 TB storage, extra usage, access to all models. Pro 181 €/month — 5 TB storage, significantly increased usage, dedicated support, early access to new features. Enterprise custom (SSO/SAML, SCIM & IAM, audit logs, VPC and on-prem, ZDR, data residency, SLAs).
